strings: It's not uncommon for m_c to come into the medicine den with worries and troubles swirling around {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head. r_c0 has a specific pile of herbs set aside just for when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/need/needs} them. And {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject} {VERB/r_c0/are/is} prepared simply for when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/need/needs} to talk.
m_c's tail lashes, fur standing uncomfortably on end as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/share/shares} some of the anxieties bothering {PRONOUN/m_c/object} with a Clanmate.
The sunshine offers no relief to m_c as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/pace/paces} around the camp entrance, on edge.
m_c keeps going in circles, worriedly pacing and unable to settle down to sleep properly.
